description: Head of the one small western caravan camped this winter in the yards outside the west wall. Sixties, small, bow-legged from a life on camels, a long grey braid. Speaks a trader's Chinese: nouns and prices, few verbs. Xu Ping cannot say his name.
knows: that Xu Ping treated his driver's frozen feet and took nothing for it
that Xu Ping carries a piece of cloth that smells strongly of the green, and that it has been worn on a man's body
who in Chang'an bought his caravan's whole stock of the green: a Han broker called Yan
last_seen: the camp in the yards outside the west wall, afternoon of the fifth day
name: The old trader
not_knows: whose clothes the cloth came from
where Yan sold the green on
Xu Ping's name — he did not ask
owes_owed: owes Xu Ping for the driver's feet
toward_player: Amused, and in his debt, and prepared to be useful up to a point. Does not ask what the physician wants it for.
voice: Answers with a price, a place or a gesture before he answers with a word. Laughs at his own customers.
